title: Bounded flat representative of a restricted complex and its constant tensor
statement: Let f:Y→X, A, S, R, E and F be as in [lem-sfb-coefficient-restricted-tensor-comparison]. Let K in the ordinary derived category of S-modules [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data] have zero cohomology above some integer b. There exists a cochain complex P of intrinsic R-modules with zero terms above an integer bound and satisfying the acyclic-tensor K-flat condition, together with a derived isomorphism D(F)(K) ≅ Q(E(P)), and, for every A-module M, a derived isomorphism D(F)(K ⊗^L_S constant_X(M)[0]) ≅ Q(E(constant_Y(M) ⊗_R P)). Here E acts termwise on complexes. No finite generation, local constancy, or Noetherianity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 06YU, definition-derived-tor, and Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; flat representative substep of det-lem-integral-models-stacks proof steps 2 and 3.

proof.text: Put L = D(E)^{-1}(D(F)(K)). Exactness of E and F identifies E(H^j L) with F(H^j K). Applying F to the upper bound on K, then reflecting zero objects through E, proves the same upper cohomology bound for L.

Use the existing generic bounded_flat_representative construction: truncate a representative of L above the cohomology bound, then apply its functorial bounded-above flat replacement. This gives Q(P) ≅ L, a term bound, flat terms, and K-flatness. The equivalence counit and exact functor representative factorization give D(F)(K) ≅ Q(E(P)).

Apply the derived restricted constant-tensor comparison, transport its first factor from L to Q(P), and use the proved K-flat single-tensor comparison to identify the tensor with the localization of termwise tensorRight by constant_Y(M). Braiding changes tensorRight to tensorLeft. The exact E representative factorization gives the required isomorphism.

theorem coefficient_restricted_tensor_flat_model
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (K : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A)
    (hK : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j →
      IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ j).obj K)) :
    let R := constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A
    let S := constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A
    let E := coefficientModelFixedScalars (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A
    let F := coefficientModelFixedScalars (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A ⋙
      coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} f A
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Mod S)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (Sheaf (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (Mod R) ℤ,
      (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j → IsZero (P.X j)) ∧
      P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat ∧
      Nonempty (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ∧
      ∀ M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A,
        Nonempty (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (((SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor S).obj K).obj
              ((Q S).obj ((HomologicalComplex.single (Mod S) (.up ℤ) 0).obj
                ((commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor
                  (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A).obj M)))) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((tensorLeft ((commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor
              (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A).obj M)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
